top_signals.title: Philips and GE investigating Clop ransomware data theft claims
top_signals.summary: Tech giants General Electric (GE) and Philips have also confirmed they're investigating claims that the Clop ransomware gang breached their systems and stole data. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Consumer Resilience Starting to Show Cracks, Says RBC’s Calvasina
top_signals.summary: Lori Calvasina, head of US equity strategies at RBC, examines US consumer resilience ahead of retail earnings this week and explains why she doesn’t see any impediments to the buy America trade. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Alibaba answers Meta’s AI challenge with new laptop-ready model
top_signals.summary: Alibaba launched a laptop-ready AI model and released the weights of its most powerful Qwen model, escalating its rivalry with Meta in open-weight AI.

top_signals.title: JAL and ANA to coordinate flight schedules for first time
top_signals.summary: The move affects flights by the two major Japanese airlines on the route between Haneda Airport in Tokyo and Okayama Airport in western Japan, starting in late October.
